name: Speak with Bink
summary: Magis Sparkmantle sends you to Bink in Ironforge, where her studies need an arcane specialist.

sections.title: A Colleague's Summons
sections.body: Bink seeks someone who can wield magic and aid her work. Near Kharanos, Magis Sparkmantle sends apprentices who have outgrown their early exercises to answer Bink's call.

sections.title: The Hall of Mysteries
sections.body: In Ironforge's Mystic Ward, Bink studies in the Hall of Mysteries. Scholars, priests, and arcanists gather there. She watches each arriving apprentice closely, for raw potential without discipline can make a spellcaster dangerous in arcane work.

faq.answer: Magis Sparkmantle sends novice Alliance mages from Dun Morogh to Bink once they have advanced beyond their early training.
Bink is in the Hall of Mysteries, in the Mystic Ward in northern Ironforge.

faq.q: Why does Bink only want a mage?
faq.answer: Bink studies arcane energies and sensitive monitoring equipment. She believes non-mages cannot handle the magical details and dangers involved.

aliases: what comes after speak with bink
faq.answer: After greeting you and assessing your abilities, Bink asks you to help with her research, which continues with Mage-tastic Gizmonitor.

faq.q: Is this quest available to classes other than mages?
faq.answer: No. Bink's call is for mages, taking them from local novice training to specialized work in the capital.

faq.q: What is the Hall of Mysteries?
faq.answer: The Hall of Mysteries is Ironforge's center for arcane and holy study. Trainers, scholars, and researchers there represent the magical arts of dwarves and gnomes.

angles.text: As a mage, you leave introductory valley training for the wider work of Ironforge's arcane scholars.
As a gnome, you find Bink and Magis Sparkmantle carrying on gnomish arcane tradition in Ironforge's welcoming halls after Gnomeregan's loss.
As an Alliance member, you see gnomish intellect and dwarven hospitality joined in study at the Hall of Mysteries.
